# Retained trial 22 evaluator fixture

These four files are byte-for-byte copies from
`164b126c97ec06dcb494618dd959057250b4e513`, under
`docs/results/benchmark-remediation/attempt-22/`.
`sha256.json` records their original content identities.

They exercise reconstruction of a real retained local workload and all raw
observations, plus deliberate corruption controls. Their implementation revisions,
paths, measurements and outcomes remain historical. They are not measurements of
this benchmark-only candidate and do not establish a new performance result.
The rest of the trial and every failed/rejected investigation are preserved in the
separate full-history/evidence archive, indexed by `docs/benchmark-evidence.md`.
